description: There are many different ways to display Balance Sheet data. What we were missing was a Visual which displays a Balance Sheet in a very easy-to-understand way and still allows the end-user to do some analysis. This is why we have developed the Balance Sheet Visual for Power BI. It displays Assets and Liabilities in a visual way but also allows the user to drill down into the details. Download the latest version of the sample report to see the visual in action.
